mapper.sql: task_id, parent_task_id, project_id, milestone_id, task_type_id, task_status_id, title, content, assignee_user_id, priority_code, progress_rate, start_date, due_date, estimated_hours, actual_hours, is_deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_at, est_start_date, est_end_date, attachment_group_id, editor_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT t.task_id, t.parent_task_id, t.milestone_id, t.task_type_id, t.task_status_id, t.title, t.content, t.assignee_user_id, u.user_name, t.priority_code, c.code_name, t.progress_rate, t.start_date, t.due_date, p.project_name, t2.type_name, t3.status_name FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN task_types t2 ON t.task_type_id = t2.task_type_id LEFT JOIN task_statuses t3 ON t.task_status_id = t3.task_status_id LEFT JOIN common_code c ON t.priority_code = c.code_value LEFT JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.project_id = #{id} OR p.parent_project_id = #{pid}
